translations.web: The sorrows of a travailing woman will come on him. He is an unwise son; for when it is time, he doesn’t come to the opening of the womb.
translations.bsb: Labor pains come upon him, but he is an unwise son. When the time arrives, he fails to present himself at the opening of the womb.
translations.kjv: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son; for he should not stay long in the place of the breaking forth of children.
translations.asv: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son; for it is time he should not tarry in the place of the breaking forth of children.
